description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120); CREATE TABLE V (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_V PRIMARY KEY, M1 MEMO, M2 MEMO); Close. One shared session adds ID 1 with M1 and M2 each 30 U+20AC characters (60 bytes each, sum 120 > 64) through a table recordset (AddNew/Update) and closes. Page 0 bytes 3584-3591, page 1 and pages 42-53 are read after create and after insert (pages 0-55 hashed), and FieldSize of M1 and M2 read back. Asks whether both 60-byte Memos are stored inline or whether a per-row budget pushes one or both to LVAL pages.
retentionNote: r-q22-lv-open: R-FMT-2 long-value open cases (ACE 2007 ACCDB)
